world.summary: Closed the sea-compact review findings and both docking fixes (uncommitted, in worktree-world). (1) validateSeaMap refuses a sea over MAX_SEA_SIDE_TILES=112; maps.test.ts shows 113-wide and 113-tall failing, 112 passing. (2) simulation.test.ts handling baseline BEFORE is a full literal of every e2a80af ShipTuning field (+16 px), plus dockRadius>=384. (3) Sea keyboard tap test dispatches keydown/keyup Events (checks preventDefault, non-helm keys pass through); blur clears the tap; isTyping is safe without HTMLInputElement; text-field guard tested via vi.stubGlobal. (4) visibility bound is 3 * shipTuning.maxSpeed. (5) sketch split into pure assets/source/maps/sliceSeaSketch.ts (sliceSeaTmj()) + sketch.ts entry; `node assets/source/maps/sketch.ts` reproduces slice-sea.tmj byte for byte; maps.test.ts compares the generator with the ?raw .tmj. (6) sail(): interact within reach with a clear hull path moors at any speed; HUD hint is always 'Press E to dock at X'; new sweep over headings 24..56 (every 8, into the berth's open E/S sides), speeds 0/19/39 and lateral offsets across the reach; existing speed-gate tests updated; sail-and-dock asserts hud-dock data-dock and that the hint shows while backing off. (7) InputGate.lapsedAt + MatchRoom omit a lapsed client's entry; step() keeps a moored ship untouched when its entry is missing; unit + headless integration test (dock with ahead+E, 400 ms silence, resume ahead with E released: still moored; astern, or release then ahead, casts off). The integration test fails with the MatchRoom change reverted. (8) architecture.md docking paragraph rewritten (shorter than before); README and maps README updated. Checks run here after npm ci: npm run typecheck (pass), npm run test:unit (555/555), npm run test:integration (38/38, twice; match.test.ts 5/5 runs), npm run build (pass incl. smoke), full playwright suite 6/6 with JSON report and check-report OK, sail-and-dock --repeat-each=5: 5/5 passed, npm run map:check up to date.
open_assumptions: Sweep lanes: a lane counts as approaching an open side when its closest point to the berth has a clear straight hull run to the berth. Lanes that instead hit the land beside the dock (e.g. head-on at over ~322 sub-units lateral offset) run aground there, some outside the reach, because the clear-path rule is unchanged; those lanes are excluded from the sweep.
ShipTuning.dockMaxSpeed is kept (decisions say it stays) but mooring and the HUD no longer read it; it is documented as a slow-approach reference and tests still check its share of full speed.

sail-and-dock no longer requires that the 'Press E' hint was seen on the way in, because the ship now moors on the first step in reach and a 20 Hz patch can skip that one step. It requires every hint seen to be '' or 'Press E to dock at X', and that the hint shows while backing off after casting off.
docs/architecture.md grew by 7 bytes overall (the 112-tile ceiling line); the docking paragraph is shorter than before.
